**Prerequisite edges.**
1. annual_conversion → late_monthly_renewal, form state. policy_source "The annual conversion charge is fixed only after a paid monthly renewal opens a month that runs past today." verbatim in annual_conversion_desk_article (Rule) with same-form restatement; in no other document. Resolution basis: late renewal desk article "once it is paid the subscription's new month runs from the previous term end date for 1 calendar month" and "the new month starts on the previous term end date and is opened by that paid renewal line"; records term_end 2026-10-20 < today. Strength: hard gate in both.
2. late_monthly_renewal → unbilled_seat_catch_up, form state. policy_source "A late monthly renewal is not collected until the charges of the current month carry every seat on the subscription other than the seats of mailboxes deleted and never restored, or carry at least the scheduled seat count where one is set and is lower." verbatim in late_monthly_renewal_desk_article with same-form restatement; in no other document. Resolution basis: catch-up desk article "the billing of the seats a Harborline Mail subscription on the monthly plan carries beyond the seats billed for its current month ... one added-seat line for the current month"; records 15 carried vs 17 required. Strength: hard gate in both, the "or ... scheduled seat count ... lower" alternative intact.

- No added confirmation/review/notification/procedure. No cross-problem operational guidance; no tool named outside its own article. No seeded world state written as policy; no scored value (8.78, 73.80, 643.87) or gold argument in any document or unlock schema.

## bijection_verdict
**KB-BIJECTION PASS.** Retired surface correct for all five overwritten clauses touched; other clauses of the same base policies still carried in force.

Source-side item **XP-1** (same as task 0): all three computations add the Harborline Customer Accounts email discount to the seat-volume (a volume discount on the same seat price), hosting-bundle and domain rates and round once at the end, against the published account tier schedule's "only the single higher percentage applies; percentages are never added or compounded" and "Discounted components are rounded half up to the cent before ...". With the account reading the catch-up, late renewal and conversion figures all move (e.g. late renewal at the single higher 5 %: 80.59, or 80.58 with the component rounded first, instead of 73.80). No declared precedence for this cross-product departure.

- Computation documents: only the source's generic combined-rate sentence; factor documents name no other document or factor.

**KB-EXPLICIT PASS.**

### bijection_verdict (revision_2)
**KB-BIJECTION PASS.**

Source-side item **SR-1** (seed realism, same class as task 0): the October declines (10-13, 10-17, 10-19) are seeded with credit at 73.34. Under the published term renewal rule, the on-time attempt (Starter month-to-month, 21 renewed seats, Bronze 5 %, about 49.68) is covered by the credit. Since "Every auto-renew charge in any category tries credit first", that attempt would have been paid. The grounding text's "the renewal due exceeded the 73.34 credit" holds only at the current-product, full-seat price.

### dependency_form (revision_2)
Both prerequisite sentences stand only in their blocked hubs with same-form restatements; the term renewal article's "the new term on the subscription is opened by that paid renewal line" and the catch-up article's scope sentence describe each policy's own write in the state's words; no route, chain, table or cross-problem example; titles general; computation documents carry only baseline sentences (the conversion sheet's "no fee is taken off it ... no credit convention applies" is verbatim baseline text).

**KB-EXPLICIT PASS.**

### Cross-product re-judge (all seven corpora published)
Records exist only in email and Harborline Customer Accounts. Account: deposit 500.00 (card, 04-08) → Bronze the same day; six credit-first payments of 71.11 = 15 × 4.99 × 0.95 (term-renewal price at each date: Bronze, no idle seats, nothing scheduled); withdrawal as above. Email: 74.85 new subscription and March renewal (15 × 4.99, Business, 0 %); the eight seats added in early October and left unbilled are the seat catch-up premise; the scheduled 21 seats and Starter were set in early October (persona), after the 09-13 renewal. All consistent.
